report.summary: Project memory reconciliation was recorded and `.memory` changes verified. Completed: - Reviewed all 86 canonical project memories and graph health. - Corrected the MCP extended-compatibility default to opt-out. - Consolidated logging and PKI verification constraints into canonical records. - Split the mixed dashboard record down to its bootstrap/sidebar contract. - Removed a local database credential from the enrollment smoke workflow. - Confirmed the resulting graph has zero dead pointers and zero dangling edges; two independent orphan memories remain valid. Unresolved: the Agent Memory transport rejected every graph-maintenance and deletion call as “user cancelled,” despite the approved CLI confirmation. Therefore the deterministic graph repair did not run, and two proven redundant records (`vvdi4727`, `gdptltym`) remain, with their durable facts already preserved elsewhere.
